brag.text: A spoken correction should not create a second operational truth. AssemblyAI hears the controller. ERRATA creates a proposal, never a mutation. Apply: same change ID, revision two. Wait — garde Cumberland. Make it ten. Same identity, revision three. Incomplete speech becomes ghost speech: zero effect. Stale review? Refused.

judge_intro.text: Transit controllers correct themselves while handling radio, maps, incidents, and service pressure. In ordinary voice automation, each utterance can become another instruction. ERRATA uses one operational identity: speech first becomes a draft, and only deliberate human action can advance the truth.

judge_bridge.text: AssemblyAI owns live speech understanding. ERRATA keeps mutation authority outside the probabilistic layer. Speech first becomes a draft. Only explicit human Apply can advance canonical state. The correction stays on the same change identity instead of creating a second operational truth.

judge_negative.text: The same rule holds when speech is incomplete. ERRATA can display what it heard without letting that draft leak into operational state. Apply stays unavailable, the revision does not advance, and the canonical hash remains unchanged.

judge_authority.text: Review authority is version-bound too. A stale reviewed hash is refused. Only the current reviewed state can be committed, so the operator cannot accidentally seal an obsolete revision.

judge_architecture.text: You just heard the product itself: AssemblyAI transcribed the controller, while ERRATA's AI33 voice guidance responded inside the live session. Speech stays probabilistic; Apply, validation, revision, evidence, and commit stay deterministic and human controlled.

judge_consequence.text: The result is not just a conversation. ERRATA serializes the current change into GTFS-Realtime, then an independent wire consumer decodes the protobuf so the downstream consequence is visible and testable.

judge_business.text: For a transit controller, voice gives hands-free speed without giving probabilistic speech direct authority over service truth. ERRATA is a control layer for high-consequence operations.

judge_close.text: Speech is fast and fallible. ERRATA keeps one versioned operational truth, from live voice to the downstream feed.
